SHARED-F-2-S31.title: Consent Data Schema and Pydantic Contracts
SHARED-F-2-S31.description: Define consent data model schema and validation contracts including consent tier, timestamp, user/session linkage, and consent status. Implement Pydantic models aligned with existing tool_models patterns to enforce input/output consistency.

SHARED-F-2-S32.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Exposure
